On the other hand, platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide user-friendly interfaces but are only available in a handful of countries, effectively locking out creators in regions like Africa and South Asia. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, however, empowers you to build a fully operational online store without reliance on any of these conventional platforms. How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in just 46 countries out of 195 globally, meaning millions of creators are left without options. While they claim to be a global service, their restrictive policies exclude many potential users. PayPal also has a limited footprint and often restricts services based on the user's location, leaving creators in countries like Ghana and Venezuela out in the cold. In stark contrast, COREMERCH is designed specifically for the underserved markets. By utilizing decentralized infrastructures like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, anyone can set up a commerce stack tailored to their needs, regardless of their geographic restrictions. This structural alternative not only bypasses the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors but also ensures that you maintain sovereignty over your digital commerce.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors when choosing a platform for selling stock photos. PayPal may offer quick transactions, but their hidden fees can cut into your profits significantly. Stripe's fees are relatively transparent, but their service is not available in many regions, and the costs can add up quickly. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack offers a competitive edge with only a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Transactions on recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON incur minimal fees, often less than $0.10, ensuring that you keep more of your earnings. This combination of low fees and fast processing times gives you a clear financial advantage and peace of mind.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, traditional platforms often impose terms that can jeopardize your revenue. If your account gets suspended, you risk losing access to your funds and your customer data. COREMERCH offers complete ownership of your infrastructure after deployment. You have full control over your data and transactions, with no ongoing subscriptions or hidden fees. The Edge Commerce Stack automates payment processing and product delivery, allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing your store. This level of automation streamlines your workflow and ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly, enhancing their experience while freeing you from operational burdens.
